description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' that displays a list of notes with features such as search, pagination, and deletion. It interacts with a backend API to fetch and manage notes data.

methods.name: NotesList
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes from the backend API based on current page, page size, and search parameters.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a note by its ID, including user confirmation and updating the notes list post-deletion.
